# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.8 — Windows compatibility baseline

<!-- update-summary: Preview.8 adds the Windows 10 version 1809 compatibility baseline, runtime capability gates, Win11 visual fallbacks, and distribution/static checks while preserving the existing 3.0 feature contracts. -->

Preview.8 is a compatibility implementation Preview. It lowers the declared
runtime minimum to 64-bit Windows 10 version 1809 (Build 17763) or later,
including Windows 11, while keeping the existing WinUI/Win32 architecture and
the bounded 3.0 feature slice.

## Compatibility changes

- `DropSpace.Core.Compatibility` now owns the shared minimum-build policy,
  capability states, and OS/API/runtime probe contracts.
- The App layer reads the real Windows kernel build and blocks direct Portable
  launches below Build 17763 with a diagnostic marker. MSIX, identity, Inno
  Setup, and update manifests declare the same minimum.
- Mica and modern DWM corner/border attributes are selected only when the
  Windows 11 capability is present. Windows 10 uses a solid base visual and
  retains Clipboard, Dynamic Island, OLE, Smart Drag, Classic fallback,
  placement, and updater paths.
- Optional PDF/media and Windows Share API states are reported as capabilities;
  missing optional APIs do not become an implicit startup or drop-path claim.

## Validation and evidence boundary

- CI and the release workflow now run `scripts/Test-WindowsCompatibility.ps1`
  before restore/build, in addition to the existing localization, policy,
  packaging, lifecycle, smoke, and update checks.
- Core policy tests cover the inclusive Build 17763 boundary, and updater tests
  reject manifests below that boundary.
- The full acceptance matrix is documented in
  [compatibility-baseline.md](../../compatibility-baseline.md) and
  [the Preview.8 test plan](../../docs/test-plan/v0.3.0-preview.8.md): Windows
  10 1809/1909/20H2/22H2, Windows 11 21H2/22H2/23H2/24H2, 100–200% DPI, one to
  three monitors, packaging, clipboard, drag/drop, startup, and updater paths.

This Preview is **CONDITIONAL** until those historical Windows builds,
mixed-DPI/multi-monitor layouts, Explorer/provider behavior, and the existing
two-device/network/browser gates have executable evidence. This development
environment is Linux-only and cannot honestly provide that Windows evidence.
Hosted Windows CI proves the current build/smoke path but does not substitute
for the complete OS matrix. Public artifacts may be unsigned; verify
`SHA256SUMS.txt` and download only from this GitHub Release.

Stable-channel users will not receive this Preview. Select the Preview channel
only to test the compatibility build.
